info.name: eLearning Template Engine API
info.description:
Backend API for the composable component-based eLearning authoring platform.
Supports 89+ component types, per-interaction audio, page completion tracking,
weighted scoring, full theming (layout + color system), and SCORM 1.2/2004 export.

item.name: List all pages in a course (ordered) (listPages)
Get a page with its components (getPage)
Update page metadata, layout, or theme (updatePage)
Delete a page and its components (deletePage)
Add a component to a page (addComponent)
Remove a component from a page (deleteComponent)
List all component categories with counts (listComponentCategories)
List component types in a category (listCategoryComponents)
Get resolved page theme (with course inheritance) (getPageTheme)
List branching rules for a course (listBranchRules)
Get a discussion thread with replies (getDiscussion)
Add a reply to a discussion thread (addDiscussionReply)
Add a peer review to a submission (addPeerReview)
List all audio items across all pages and components (getCourseNarration)
Export SCORM package from raw JSON (exportCourseFromJson)
Export SCORM package from a DB-persisted course (exportPersistedCourse)
